title: Pentax K-1 Mark II 36.4MP Weather-Sealed Full-Frame DSLR (Best Value Full-Frame DSLR)
purpose: The rugged landscape and fine-art full-frame DSLR titan ('Best Value Full-Frame DSLR'): 36.4MP AA-filter-free Full-Frame CMOS sensor, PRIME IV engine with Pentax Accelerator Unit, 5-axis SR II in-body stabilization, Pixel Shift Resolution System II (Dynamic handheld full-RGB color synthesis), AstroTracer GPS star-tracking, and tank-like 87-seal weatherproof magnesium alloy build.

sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 35.9 x 24.0mm Full-Frame CMOS sensor without Anti-Aliasing Filter (36.4MP, 7360 x 4912) with 5-Axis Shake Reduction II
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: 35mm native full-frame field of view (100% 0.70x optical pentaprism viewfinder)
sensor_and_optics.lens: HD PENTAX-D FA* 50mm F1.4 SDM AW (Star-Series Weather-Sealed Reference Prime, Aero Bright Coating II, 9 rounded blades)
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: ISO 100 base sensor sensitivity (ISO 100–819,200 ultra-high sensitivity range, 14-bit RAW)
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 14.6 EV dynamic range with Pixel Shift Resolution II capturing true R-G-B color at every single pixel without Bayer demosaicing moire
sensor_and_optics.shutter: 1/8000s to 30 minutes weather-sealed shutter rated to 300,000 cycles, 5-axis 5-stop SR II IBIS, AstroTracer sensor-shift star tracking

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Dramatic wilderness golden hour, storm-clearing mountain light, or dark-sky astrophotography illumination at Base ISO 100
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Rich Pentax Custom Image tonal transport (Natural / Landscape / Fine Sharpness) with deep emerald foliage, cobalt skies, and zero color moire via Pixel Shift full-color sampling

surface_rendering: AA-filter-free 36.4MP Full-Frame sensor with Pixel Shift Resolution II resolving micro-fine geological strata, alpine lichens, bark, skin pores, and fine fabric threads with true per-pixel RGB color fidelity
HD Pentax Coating and Aero Bright Coating II delivering crystal-clear micro-contrast and suppressing flare against direct mountain sunlight
Authentic three-dimensional Pentax Limited & Star-series optical rendering with rich, painterly color depth
depth_and_optics: SAFOX 12 33-point phase-detection autofocus (25 cross-type points) with 86,000-pixel RGB exposure metering
5-axis Shake Reduction II (5 stops) enabling razor-sharp handheld high-resolution exposures in rugged outdoor environments
Full-frame 35mm optical depth of field with smooth, organic transition from tack-sharp foreground to atmospheric background

execution_directive: Enforce Pentax K-1 Mark II 36.4MP AA-filter-free Full-Frame DSLR optical physics with Pixel Shift Resolution II per-pixel RGB fidelity, 5-axis SR II stabilization, and HD PENTAX-D FA* Star-series weather-sealed glass.
